config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Without it, the first tool call creates a Free account (5,000 credits/month) you can claim later. ZENROWS_AUTO_SIGNUP=false opts out. Keys: https://app.zenrows.com/account/settings

config.label: Bearer <ZENROWS_API_KEY> or OAuth
config.description: Bearer <ZENROWS_API_KEY> or OAuth. Needed for tool calls only. No auto-signup; agents can POST https://app.zenrows.com/api/agent/signup for a key (it may ask a short question first).
